description: This file defines the class MongoTimestampPersistence, which implements timestamp storage and retrieval using MongoDB within a reactive streams context. It handles creating and managing capped collections in MongoDB, inserting timestamps (with optional tags), and fetching the latest timestamps.

classes.name: MongoTimestampPersistence
classes.description: A final class implementing timestamp persistence using MongoDB's capped collections in a reactive streams environment. It provides methods to set and retrieve timestamps, handling collection creation with backoff retries.

methods.name: initializedInstance
methods.description: Creates and initializes a new MongoTimestampPersistence instance, setting up the capped collection source.

methods.name: setTimestamp
methods.description: Sets the current timestamp in the MongoDB collection, returning a source signaling completion.

methods.name: setTaggedTimestamp
methods.description: Sets a timestamp with an optional tag in the collection.

methods.name: getCollection
methods.description: Retrieves the MongoCollection instance from the source.

methods.name: getTimestampAsync
methods.description: Fetches the most recent timestamp asynchronously.

methods.name: getTaggedTimestamp
methods.description: Retrieves the latest timestamp with its associated tag.
